high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "kaiagerber." The post features a woman standing against a plain, light-colored wall. She has long, wavy brown hair that is styled in loose waves, and she is wearing a black, beaded dress with short sleeves and a deep V-neckline. The dress has intricate beadwork and fringe details along the shoulders and upper chest area. She accessorizes with a delicate choker necklace and matching earrings. The woman is posing for the camera, looking directly at it with a neutral expression.
